title: 第1283章 最美第1282章 清算之路
slug: 南疆炼蛊三十载世人敬我如敬神
content_zh:
第1283章最美
一句我要她，各方皆错愕。
哪怕是得到了永生种，也挡不住帝妖的容颜魅力吗？
帝妖是很美，许多至高绝巅都见过其真容，只是一面便永生难忘，但都能克制内心欲望。
因为对美的追求只是诸多大修所行路上很小的一部分，甚至可以说不值一提。
帝妖再美，也只是绝巅中最弱小的一个。
从来没有一位大修真正拜倒在帝妖的石榴裙下，从来都只有帝妖独自美丽。
众人都没想到，以李元的心性，修行至今不近女色的表现，竟然会在乎一个帝妖？
此刻，炎夏古国的其他古帝尽皆看向帝妖。
帝烈嗤笑一声，“帝妖，你不是一直内心骚乱，说只有李元配得上你，想要和李元结合吗？现在机会来了。”
“他果然心系于我呢。”
帝妖戴着面纱，声音柔润动听，心中更是傲然。
她是世间最美的女人，自然要配世间最强的男人。
念及此处，帝妖笑得愈发灿烂。
帝天却是眉头微皱，“帝妖，你想好了吗？”
“当然。”帝妖笑靥如花，“无疆尊者仙威盖世，未来只会更强，跟着这样强大的男人，哪怕只有一瞬间就会死，我也愿意。”
丑陋弱小的人许以一生的承诺，帝妖绝不会多看一眼，但她甘愿把自己所有的美好，不为人知的一面，都奉献给最倾心的那个人。
帝天轻叹一声，又道：“我们十三古帝，就如兄弟姐妹，你若不愿去，我们可以和李元谈。”
“哪怕谈不拢，哪怕血战到底！”
“但你选了，就再无回头路了。”

这是帝天最后的提醒。
“不必考虑了，我愿意。”帝妖没有丝毫的犹豫，“我生来如此，哪怕举世倾心于我，我也只会追随那个让我仰望倾慕的人。”
“好。”
帝天点头，不再多言，让开了道路。
帝妖走出，越过其他古帝，一步步走向立于天地间的李元，此刻世间最耀眼的存在。
她一步步揭开面纱。
帝妖的容颜无法被形容，但此刻所有生灵都不由看着她，在每一个人心中，她都是不一样的。
她就是世间最美！
尤其是那些绝巅之下的修士，远远看着，哪怕看不清，看得模糊，只是惊鸿一瞥，便彻底沦陷。
如果不是李元的威压太恐怖，那些爱慕者早如蛊虫一样蜂拥而至了。
李元的脸色却很平静，眼中没有泛起一丝波澜。
帝妖？容颜道？
content_en:
Chapter 1283 The most beautiful
The words "I want her" shocked everyone.
Even if you get the immortal seed, can't you stop the charm of the emperor demon's face?
The Emperor Demon is very beautiful. Many high and mighty people have seen his true appearance. Just one look will be unforgettable, but he can restrain his inner desires.
Because the pursuit of beauty is only a very small part of the journey of many major practitioners, it can even be said to be not worth mentioning.
No matter how beautiful the Emperor Demon is, he is only the weakest among the top.
There has never been a major cultivator who has truly bowed to the emperor demon's pomegranate skirt. Only the emperor demon has always been beautiful alone.
No one expected that with Li Yuan's character and his lack of lewdness in his practice, he would actually care about an emperor demon?
At this moment, all the other ancient emperors of Yanxia Ancient Kingdom looked at the emperor demon.
Di Lie sneered, "Di Yao, haven't you been turbulent in your heart, saying that only Li Yuan is worthy of you, and want to combine with Li Yuan? Now is your chance."
"He really cares about me."
The emperor demon wore a veil, his voice was soft and sweet, and his heart was even more proud.
She is the most beautiful woman in the world, so she naturally deserves the strongest man in the world.
Thinking of this, Emperor Yao smiled even brighter.
Di Tian frowned slightly, "Emperor Yao, have you thought about it?"
"Of course." Emperor Yao smiled as brightly as a flower, "The Supreme Immortal is so powerful that he will only become stronger in the future. Following such a powerful man, I am willing to die even if it only takes a moment."
The ugly and weak person made a lifelong promise, and the emperor demon would never look at it twice, but she was willing to dedicate all her beauty and unknown side to the person she loved the most.
Di Tian sighed softly and said: "We Thirteen Ancient Emperors are like brothers and sisters. If you don't want to go, we can talk to Li Yuan."
"Even if we can't reach an agreement, even if we fight to the bitter end!"
"But once you choose, there's no turning back."
This is Ditian's last reminder.
"No need to think about it, I am willing." Emperor Yao did not hesitate at all, "I was born like this. Even if the whole world falls in love with me, I will only follow the person who makes me look up to and admire."
"Okay."
Di Tian nodded, said no more, and moved out of the way.
The emperor demon walked out, passed the other ancient emperors, and walked step by step towards Li Yuan, who stood between heaven and earth, the most dazzling existence in the world at this moment.
She lifted the veil step by step.
The appearance of the Emperor Yao cannot be described, but at this moment all living beings can't help but look at her. In everyone's heart, she is different.
She is the most beautiful in the world!
Especially those monks who are at the top of their game, looking at it from a distance, even if they can't see clearly or blurry, they just take a startling glance and they are completely defeated.
If Li Yuan's coercion hadn't been so terrifying, those admirers would have swarmed here like insects.
Li Yuan's face was very calm, and there was no wave in his eyes.
Emperor demon? Rongyandao?
